posts.text: A federal court sentenced former Wisconsin judge Hannah Dugan to a fine and no prison time for obstructing an ICE immigration arrest.  The judge explained that, while the crime had been committed, Dugan’s character and upstanding past needed to be taken in consideration.
posts.summary: Questions lenient sentencing of judge who obstructed ICE arrest

posts.text: Bad legal news for Trump: a federal court has rejected the DOJ request to use a grand jury subpoena to obtain the names and addresses of virtually anyone involved in the 2020 Fulton County election.  The judge decided that the subpoena was overly broad and could not lead to any criminal charge, since the statute of limitations had passed.
posts.summary: Court rejects overly broad subpoena in Trump election case

posts.text: Why does the Pledge of Allegiance say “One Nation Under God”? Because Congress added those words in 1954, during the so called “Red Scare”, to push back against the USSR. But our Founding Fathers created a Constitution that contains no reference to Christianity.  People like @YoungPatriots_IL don’t understand that.
